The '''Temple Spire''', also referred to as the '''Tranquility Spire''', was the highest of the five spires of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The Spire was the most sacred site in the Temple and emanated a contemplative atmosphere. By the late [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Temple Spire also housed a [[Pinnacle Room/Legends|Jedi Council chamber]].

==History==
Established above and around the [[Sacred spire/Legends|sacred spire]], the mountain which contained the [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] in which the Temple was originally contained, the tower stood taller than the surrounding Council spires. As the building grew, it came to completely cover and reshape much of the mountain, with its peak remaining in its original shape within the spire.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

[[File:Ruinsoftowers.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Temple Spire; damaged and listing to the side; as viewed from the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]].]]

At the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] fell to the dark side and began to carry out [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], he went to the Temple and began his [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|slaughter]] of all of its occupants.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Temple Spire's base was heavily bombed by [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAATs]], causing the Tower to list. While it lay empty for over a decade, it was occasionally visited by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], searching for hidden knowledge.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], the spire collapsed, revealing the sacred spire underneath. It is here that the deranged [[Lord Nyax]] would do [[Attack on the Sacred Spire|battle]] with Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his [[Mara Jade Skywalker|wife]], and Knight [[Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="ELII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

==Layout==
The tallest of the Temple's five spires, the Temple Spire was filled largely with turbolifts which carried visitors to the tower up and down. As passengers traveled up within the turbolifts, visitors were able to view the history of the Order through transparisteel windows. Mosaics, [[Heritage tapestry|heritage tapestries]] and towering memorial statues of the most revered Jedi which were suspended within the tower on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pads. At the base of the tower, the original mountain peak of the [[Sacred spire/Legends|sacred spire]] jutted out of the Temple Ziggurat and was encircled by transparisteel hallways which overlooked the barren slopes of the edifice. Pathways led from the outer halls onto the mountain and through it, leading down into ancient chapels and temples. It was the site of meditation chambers and halls where the youngest Jedi were brought to have their minds opened to the vastness of the Force.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

While the bulk of the Spire contained with floating statues and murals, the summit of Temple Spire was filled with meditation chambers and halls. The [[Jedi Temple veranda|veranda]] was the name given to the upper levels of the tower which was marked by three wings which jutted out from the otherwise cylindrical section. Specialized halls and chambers were located within the wings and were used for celebrations or significant occasions. Directly below the veranda was a small hanger reserved for special Jedi transports and high-ranking Jedi. In the space directly above the veranda was the spacious [[Hall of Knighthood/Legends|Hall of Knighthood]] which served as a space for the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to elevate Padawans to the rank of Knighthood. Padawans preparing to undergo the [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|Knighting ceremony]] would spend the week prior in deep meditation in one of the veranda's private meditation rooms. During the Clone Wars, a circular chamber within the Spire's summit was used as a meeting place for the Jedi High Council. The [[Pinnacle Room/Legends|pinnacle room]] at the very summit of Tranquility Spire held the most sacred and oldest documents from the founding of the Order on Tython, many of which had been saved from destruction on Ossus.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Behind the scenes==
The novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' erroneously states that the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] are located within a third of the Tower.
